preconditions.description: The number of destinations n is between 2 and 10^5 inclusive.
The number of corridors m is between n-1 and 10^6 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a <= n and 1 <= b <= n and a != b for a, b, e in corridors)
preconditions.description: Each corridor connects two distinct valid destinations.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= e <= 10**9 for a, b, e in corridors)
preconditions.description: Each corridor energy e is between 0 and 10^9 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: len(set(tuple(sorted((a, b))) for a, b, e in corridors)) == m
preconditions.description: No pair of destinations {a, b} repeats in the input.

preconditions.expression: len(set(e for a, b, e in corridors)) == m
preconditions.description: All energy requirements e are distinct.

preconditions.expression: is_connected(n, [(a, b) for a, b, e in corridors])
preconditions.description: The graph formed by the corridors is connected.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly m - (n - 1) lines, one for each non-MST corridor.
Each output value is an integer not exceeding 10^9.

postconditions.expression: all(is_max_energy_for_non_mst_corridor(corridor, mst_edges, all_edges) == int(output_lines[i]) for i, corridor in enumerate(non_mst_corridors))
postconditions.description: For each non-MST corridor, the output is the maximum energy e such that changing the corridor's energy to e would make it part of some minimum spanning tree.
